name: seo-hreflang
summary: Inspect hreflang alternate links for structural evidence without changing international routing.
inputs: HTML file or approved page URL
approval_gates: routing, redirects, CMS, and deployment: out of scope
done_when: locale scope and environment are explicit
alternate codes and href values are inventoried
duplicates and missing href values are reported
absence is not called a defect without an international requirement
verification: source and parser limits are recorded
reciprocity and locale intent are not claimed from one page alone
